entities.span: Results are never persisted, so the only new shape is an in memory value object, Zod parsed at the Adzuna response boundary and never written to Postgres.
rejected_spans: by product decision, recorded in `docs/scope/scope.md`'s Slice 1 introduction

entities.span: If Adzuna ever returns a max below the min, the Zod schema drops both rather than passing an inverted pair forward
rejected_spans: since spec 0003's own check constraint would refuse it outright at feature 12's insert

entities.span: `postedAt` is accepted as ANY string here rather than a validated datetime
`source` is a constant, exported once as `ADZUNA_SOURCE` so feature 12 imports the same literal rather than re declaring it
`sourceJobId`, `title`, and `companyName` are trimmed and required non empty

Adzuna's response is parsed as an envelope first and then per item: a single listing that fails its own parse is dropped and counted, not treated as a reason to fail the whole page. `response_malformed` is only reported when every item in a non empty batch fails
rejected_spans: since one bad row among twenty is Adzuna's data quality, not a broken integration (feature 19 owns data quality properly; this is just refusing to let one bad row blank an otherwise good page)

entities.span: at least one of `title`/`location` is required in `SearchQuery`
page fixed to `1`
`results_per_page` is `20`
`sort_by` is omitted; Adzuna's own default (relevance) is used deliberately
rejected_spans: no sort control exists this slice (structured filters are Slice 3), and ranking intelligence arrives properly in Slice 2 rather than being approximated here by switching to a date sort

entities.span: timeout is `8000` ms, via `AbortSignal.timeout(8000)`
rejected_spans: so a hung Adzuna request fails visibly (AC-5) rather than holding the render open indefinitely

entities.span: A response whose HTTP status is not success (`res.ok` false, most likely a `429` given Adzuna's 25 calls a minute ceiling) is treated the same as a thrown error: reported as `external_service_failed`, never parsed as if it were a listings body.
rejected_spans: `fetch()` itself does not throw on a non success status, so this check is explicit rather than assumed to fall out of `attempt()`.

entities.span: "We couldn't load your saved preferences, so the fields below start empty. You can still search." It carries `role="alert"`, matching `COPY-3` and `COPY-5` and deliberately unlike `COPY-4`: this is a real failure, not the ordinary empty outcome.
rejected_spans: Added at revision 3 and written rather than left as a slot, since the sentence is the whole point of the amendment.
entities.label: COPY-6

entities.span: The five gate refusal reasons already have their sentences in `src/lib/usage-gating/copy.ts`; this feature renders those verbatim and writes no copy of its own for them.
Only a signed in caller reaches `/search`'s real content, enforced by the existing `(app)` layout guard; this feature adds no new authorization rule
rejected_spans: since a search targets nobody's data but the caller's own preferences and a public search API

entities.span: `checkUsageGate()` already verifies the caller with `getClaims()` before spending any budget; this feature adds no separate identity check.
Exactly one Adzuna call, and exactly one usage gate check, per user submitted search, never zero and never more than one
rejected_spans: so spec 0011's own accounting assumption ("the cap counts outbound API calls") holds exactly
entities.label: key invariant 1

entities.span: A usage gate refusal, or a blank query, always short circuits before any Adzuna call, enforced structurally by the `withUsageGate()` helper, never left to a caller remembering to check `allowed` first.
entities.label: key invariant 2

entities.span: Currency is never read from Adzuna; it is always the constant derived from the configured country.
entities.label: key invariant 3

entities.span: Attribution renders once per displayed listing, never once per screen. A screen with zero listings shows no attribution block.
rejected_spans: since there is nothing to attribute
entities.label: key invariant 4

entities.span: A predicted salary is never shown indistinguishably from a stated one.
entities.label: key invariant 5

entities.span: No listing data is ever written to the database by this feature. Every result is request scoped and re fetched on the next search.
entities.label: key invariant 6

entities.span: An optional field with no value (`location`, `descriptionSnippet`, either salary figure, `postedAt`) is simply omitted from the card, never rendered as a placeholder or a dash that could be mistaken for real data.
entities.label: key invariant 7

entities.span: one slot per user facing string, text left for the engineer to write before `/develop`, the same convention specs 0007 and 0011 use.
a signed in user with a `job_preference` row searches with a real title, sees real Adzuna listings with working attribution and outbound links
entities.label: Happy path

entities.span: Adzuna forced to time out and, separately, forced to return a malformed body, each renders the failure state and reports the matching kind
entities.label: Failure case: timeout and malformed body

entities.span: Adzuna forced to return a non success HTTP status (e.g. a `429`), renders the same failure state and reports `external_service_failed`
entities.label: Failure case: non success HTTP status

entities.span: a batch where one of several returned listings fails its own item level parse renders the rest normally and drops only the bad one
rejected_spans: the "every item fails" branch is a separate case, same kind
entities.label: Failure case: partial batch item parse failure

entities.span: a caller whose account week cap is already spent gets the exact `account_week_cap_reached` sentence and no Adzuna call runs
entities.label: Gate: cap reached

entities.span: `checkUsageGate()` itself forced to fail (an invalid session, or a forced database error) renders the failure state through `session_missing` or `database_unavailable` respectively, never the refusal state
entities.label: Gate failure

entities.span: a submission with both fields blank is refused before any call and spends no budget
entities.label: Validation

entities.span: a search that legitimately matches nothing renders the empty state, distinguishable from both the failure and refusal states
entities.label: Empty

entities.span: a listing carrying `salary_is_predicted: true` renders the estimate label and the Jobsworth attribution; one carrying `false` (or no salary) renders neither
entities.label: Predicted salary

entities.span: a caller with a `job_preference` row visits bare `/search` (no `q`/`where`), sees the fields prefilled, and neither `checkUsageGate()` nor the Adzuna client is called
entities.label: Prefill without spend
